mods.name: Personal Difficulty
mods.description: Let every player choose their own difficulty (Normal, Easy, Hard, Elite, Peaceful) on a shared server. Server-side only.

releases.notes:
Personal Difficulty 1.3.0

New features

- Elite difficulty: Hostile mobs can prioritise Elite players as targets, including switching from other targets in supported situations.
- Elite status effects: Certain hostile mobs can inflict temporary status effects on Elite players.
- Improved target reacquisition: Supported mobs can reacquire hidden Elite targets in limited situations.

Compatibility

- Minecraft Java Edition 26.3
- Fabric
- Requires Fabric API

Installation

1. Install Fabric Loader for Minecraft 26.3.
2. Install the matching Fabric API version.
3. Download "personal-difficulty-1.3.0.jar" from this release.
4. Place the JAR in your server's "mods" folder.
5. Restart the server.

This is a server-side mod. Players do not need to install the mod on their clients.

Verification

The build and automated test suites passed. The new behaviour was tested in a GameTest server environment; a full manual playtest with a normal Minecraft client has not been confirmed.
